findings: Native ctor registers its ManualLateUpdate with GameContext before reading Unity Time.timeScale; a failed scale read can leave its callback registered.
DeltaTime directly reads Unity Time.deltaTime on every access and applies native 10000-frame quantization; it does not cache a previous frame or multiply by cached timeScale.
SetTimeScale writes the cached field before the Unity setter. External Unity scale changes do not refresh the cached value.
GameContextController.LateUpdate invokes GameContext.ManualLateUpdate without a level-active gate. Multicast callbacks use CLR delegate ordering/snapshot semantics; exceptions abort later callbacks.
A new clock appends its callback. Old callbacks survive until the parent context explicitly clears its late delegate during Deactivate; full Deactivate and scene reset ordering remain pending.
